tools.name: check_usage
tools.description: Search the official changelog of a coding-agent CLI for a flag, command or setting (e.g. '--full-auto', 'claude -p', 'permission mode'). Returns `known` (verified usage changes, incl. ones not in recent release notes) and `hits` (matching changelog entries, newest first; breaking=true marks removals

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Latest versions of a coding-agent CLI with their changelog items. Set breaking_only to see only removals, renames and default changes.
